{heading}

{body}
""" def create_blog_post(heading: str, text: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe web display. Returns ------- str A fully formed HTML string ready to be served in a web page. Raises ------ ValueError If either heading or text is empty. """ if not heading: raise ValueError("Heading must not be empty.") if not text: raise ValueError("Text must not be empty.") # Escape user-provided content to prevent XSS (CWE-79). safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) # Convert line breaks to
for preserving formatting. safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True).replace('\n', '
\n') return BLOG_FORMAT.format(heading=safe_heading, body=safe_body)
